checks_run.procedure: Review the full product diff since round 10 (cde60365..33db1a46). Challenge D-226 to D-234 (disclosure through the tag or its key, a lost or misplaced literal, a misleading screen), D-229 and D-228 (4). Judge D-194 to D-196, D-199 item 2, D-202 and D-203 to D-205.
checks_run.command: git diff cde6036571064c12c812d240b48e3289c78d7d48..33db1a46ca498d917d9e33793e9771533269c446 -- . ':!docs/delivery'; read versions.ts (restrictedTokenTag, redactConditionLiterals, resolveRestrictedTokens, toRuleVersions, insertDraftVersion, createVersion), rules.ts, RulePage.tsx EditContent, ContentEditor.tsx, migration 0127, schema.ts, problems.json en/ar, ADR-0051 amendment parts A and B, the BE-Z15 handback; grep for selectAll/returningAll/SCHEMA_COLUMNS/to_jsonb uses that could serialize restricted_token_key
checks_run.environment: Source at 33db1a46 and the runs above
checks_run.expected: No disclosure through the tag or key, no misplaced literal, true screens; decisions acceptable or raised
checks_run.actual: Diff: 22 product files; the automation token, migration 0127, tests, ADR and data-dictionary text. Tag and key: the key is never copied to a new draft (insertDraftVersion lists its columns), is immutable (trigger) and 32 bytes (CHECK). The version presenter maps fields explicitly, the audit diff covers CONTENT_COLUMNS only, and no generic table dump uses SCHEMA_COLUMNS. Probe (l) confirms the key is absent from every served body and from the audit trail. The tag is an HMAC under a per-row secret key, so it discloses neither the id nor a literal. Every reader of the same row and revision gets the same tag (n), so it carries nothing per user. No token sequence I tried (re-save, 409 then re-send, grant between read and save, published to draft, discarded to new draft, cross-rule, forged, retired) loses or misplaces a hidden literal. Misleading screen: yes. On the stale 422 the editor shows 'This rule changed after you opened it' (en/ar), which is untrue for every UI-reachable stale case, and it hides the corrected problem text. Raised as F-DG6-700, Low (F-DG4-160 precedent), non-blocking. D-229 (connector configuration names stay cannot-name) and D-228 (4) (cross-organization ids out of scope): accepted, unchanged since round 10. Credentials are references only (fec-connector-actionable-error.png), and A12 isolation passes in en and ar (DOM-R11-08/09). D-194 to D-196, D-199 (2), D-202 and D-203: accepted, untouched by this diff. D-204: a late event is evaluated against the rule version in force and enabled at its occurrence. That keeps automation explainable and meets REQ-S12-019 and REQ-S20-013 (A13 suites green). D-205: a rule disabled now stops its pending events. The residual commit-order race documented in ADR-0043 can only run an action of a rule a person had enabled, never an approval or a gate, so it is acceptable as documented. No engineering agent or assistant path grants a business, Finance or IT approval (A21 and assistant guardrail suites green), and product G6 is not linked to DG7.

summary: PASS. F-DG6-640 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. A token copied from a published version into its draft, from another rule, or from a discarded draft, at the same row version, is now refused 422 restricted_token_stale and nothing is stored. I checked this through the API (Node 24 and 22) and through the real editor and publish flow in EN and AR. Two revert mutants are caught by my probe and by the candidate's z14/z15 tests. The issuer tag matches the ADR's HMAC, and its key is never served or audited. New F-DG6-700 (Low, non-blocking): on that refusal the editor says 'This rule changed after you opened it' in EN and AR, which is untrue, and it hides the corrected problem text. Everything else passes: 97 register integration files (1225 tests + 1 pre-existing todo), unit 38 files, domain e2e 176 + 90 (18 disclosed axe skips), demo 6, web P6 58, the build and the validators. Disclosed: my own probe bug in the first Node 22 run (fixed, re-run green), and a unit ENOENT caused by my disk cleanup in the clone (restored, re-run green). Product gate G6 is not DG7; I granted no business, Finance or IT approval.
